'''Ryan Christopher Conwell''' (born June 15, 2004) is an American [[basketball]] player for the [[Miami Heat]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college Basketball]] for the [[South Florida Bulls men's basketball|South Florida Bulls]], [[Indiana State Sycamores men's basketball|Indiana State Sycamores]], [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier Musketeers]], and [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville Cardinals]].

==Early life and high school==
As a [[Junior (education year)|junior]] at [[Pike High School]], Conwell averaged 16.4 points, 4.3 rebounds, and 2.7 assists per game.<ref>{{cite web |title=Basketball recruiting: Pike 'underdog' Ryan Conwell makes his college choice |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/high-school/2021/09/28/basketball-recruiting-2022-indianapolis-guard-ryan-conwell-picks-south-florida-bulls-brian-gregory/5897216001/ |website=IndyStar |access-date=15 March 2025}}</ref> As a [[Senior (education)|senior]], he averaged 22.6 points, 6.7 rebounds, 3.7 assists, and 3.0 steals per game.<ref>{{cite web |title=This is Indiana State's dream season and Ryan Conwell's moment |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/2024/03/09/indiana-state-basketball-in-mvc-final-behind-ryan-conwell-dream-season-arch-madness-ncaa-tournament/72915854007/ |website=IndyStar |access-date=15 March 2025}}</ref> Coming out of high school, Conwell was rated as a three-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[South Florida Bulls men's basketball|South Florida Bulls]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wood |first1=Russ |title=Ryan Conwell Signs National Letter of Intent for 2022 |url=https://usf.rivals.com/news/ryan-conwell-signs-national-letter-of-intent-for-2022 |website=Rivals.com |access-date=15 March 2025}}</ref>

==College career==
=== South Florida ===
As a [[freshman]] in 2022-23, Conwell appeared in 32 games with 21 starts, where he averaged 5.1 points per game before he entered the [[NCAA transfer portal]] three days after his head coach took another job.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wood |first1=Russ |title=South Florida freshman Ryan Conwell enters the portal |url=https://usf.rivals.com/news/south-florida-freshman-ryan-conwell-enters-the-portal |work=BullsInsider.com |publisher=Rivals.com |access-date=15 March 2025}}</ref>

=== Indiana State ===
Conwell transferred to play for the [[Indiana State Sycamores men's basketball|Indiana State Sycamores]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Pike's Ryan Conwell, 2022 Marion County Player of Year, signs with Indiana State basketball |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/high-school/2023/04/25/indiana-state-basketball-signs-former-pike-star-ryan-conwell/70152400007/ |website=IndyStar |access-date=15 March 2025}}</ref> On December 16, 2023, he scored a career-high 27 points in a win over [[2023–24 Ball State Cardinals men's basketball team|Ball State]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Former Pike star Ryan Conwell's Indy homecoming ends with career-high, Indiana State win |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/2023/12/16/indiana-state-basketball-ryan-conwell-scores-27-in-win-vs-ball-state-gainbridge-fieldhouse-pike-hs/71930498007/ |website=IndyStar |access-date=15 March 2025}}</ref> During the 2023-24 season, Conwell averaged 16.6 points, 5.8 rebounds, and 2.5 assists per game earning second-team all-[[Missouri Valley Conference]] honors.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Tipton |first1=Joe |title=Indiana State transfer guard Ryan Conwell commits to Xavier |url=https://www.on3.com/college/xavier-musketeers/news/indiana-state-transfer-guard-ryan-conwell-commits-to-xavier/ |website=On3.com |access-date=15 March 2025}}</ref> After the season, he entered his name into the NCAA transfer portal.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Jenkins |first1=Brandon |title=Indiana State second leading scorer Ryan Conwell will transfer |url=https://247sports.com/college/basketball/recruiting/article/college-basketball-transfer-portal-ryan-conwell-indiana-state-230047761/ |website=247Sports |access-date=15 March 2025}}</ref>

=== Louisville ===
On April 1, 2025, Conwell transferred to Louisville.<ref>{{cite web |title=Kelsey Inks Transfer Ryan Conwell |url=https://gocards.com/news/2025/4/11/mens-basketball-kelsey-inks-transfer-ryan-conwell |website=University of Louisville Athletics |date=April 11, 2025 |access-date=April 14, 2026}}</ref> During the 2025–26 season, he averaged a team-high 18.8 points, 4.8 rebounds, and 2.7 assists per game, earning second-team All-ACC honors.<ref>{{cite web |title=Ryan Conwell - Men's Basketball |url=https://gocards.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/ryan-conwell/16179 |website=University of Louisville Athletics |access-date=April 14, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Conwell, Brown Jr. Earn ACC Honors |url=https://gocards.com/news/2026/3/9/mens-basketball-conwell-brown-jr-earn-acc-honors |website=University of Louisville Athletics |date=March 9, 2026 |access-date=April 14, 2026}}</ref> He scored a season-high 32 points against NJIT on November 26, 2025, and later scored 31 points against NC State on February 9, 2026.<ref>{{cite web |title=Ryan Conwell - Men's Basketball |url=https://gocards.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/ryan-conwell/16179 |website=University of Louisville Athletics |access-date=April 14, 2026}}</ref> He helped lead the Cardinals to a 24–11 record and to the second round of the NCAA tournament, where Louisville defeated South Florida before losing to Michigan State.<ref>{{cite web |title=2025-26 Men's Basketball Schedule |url=https://gocards.com/sports/mens-basketball/schedule |website=University of Louisville Athletics |access-date=April 14, 2026}}</ref>

==Professional career==
On June 24, 2026, Conwell was selected by the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] with the 37th overall pick in the [[2026 NBA draft]] then immediately traded to the [[Miami Heat]] for pick 41 ([[Otega Oweh]]) and cash considerations.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/thunder/news/release-draft-oweh-260624|title=Thunder Acquires Otega Oweh|website=nba.com|date=June 24, 2026|access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>
